Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilq.qov.ph DILG OPINION NO. IO S. 2022 IAN 1 2025 HON. ATTY. LOUELLA MARIE R. AGCAOILI Municipal Councilor San Mateo, Municipal Hall San Mateo, Isabela Dear Hon. Agcaoili: This has reference to your letter dated 05 August 2024 requesting the Department's opinion on: Whether or not the Designation Order as Acting Vice Mayor issued by the Department of the Interior and Local and Government (DILG) carries with it the duty and function of being a Presiding Officer of the Sanggunian? Allow us first to state the pertinent provision of the Local Government Code. Section 49(b)l provides and we quote: Sec. 49(b) In the event of the inability of the regular presiding officer to preside at a sanggunian session, the members present and constituting a quorum shall elect from among themselves a temporary presiding officen xxx The municipal Vice Mayor is the regular presiding officer of the Sangguniang Bayan, whenever the regular presiding officer fails to preside at the sangguniang session, the members present, constituting a quorum shall elect from among themselves a temporary presiding officer. Clearly, the Vice Mayor on an approved leave of absence cannot regular preside over the sessions of the council. Sec. 49 (b) of the Local Government Code (LGC) therefore applies. Finally, your designation as Vice Mayor in an acting capacity from May 16 — June 25, 2024 and July 16 — 31 , 2024 in view of the approved leave of absence of Vice Mayor Arvin Barangan hardly matters as it does not carry with it the position of being a presiding officer of the sanggunian. 1 Local Government Code of 1991 "Matino, Mahusay, at Maaasahan" Tel. (02) 8876-3454

This view is, however, without prejudice to the authoritative decision of the courts of competent jurisdiction. Hope we have enlightened you on the matter. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: ATTY. ROMEO P. NITEZ Undersecretary for External, Legal and Legislative Affairs OUSELLA'RPB/LLLS-LRALLD/agbl Page 2 of 2
